hypotheses.name: precision_budget_scheduler
hypotheses.claim: Perceptual precision can serve as a compute-allocation signal: low uncertainty stays local, unresolved high-value uncertainty purchases more sensing/semantic computation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A fixed cascade matches task quality at equal/lower compute and latency.

hypotheses.name: evidence_debt
hypotheses.claim: Persistent unresolved visual hypotheses accumulate an evidence-debt state that should trigger refresh or active sensing before they influence high-impact actions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Evidence-debt tracking does not predict stale/wrong world beliefs or improve action safety.

hypotheses.name: negative_evidence_event
hypotheses.claim: Explicit absence should be represented as a first-class causal event, not inferred from missing positive detections.
hypotheses.falsifier: A missing-detection model matches disappearance/occlusion outcomes without extra false deletion.

hypotheses.name: perceptual_interrupt
hypotheses.claim: Rare high-risk visual prediction errors need an interrupt-like path that can pre-empt ordinary cognition without requiring full-frame global processing.
hypotheses.falsifier: Scheduled polling has equal important-event latency/recall at matched cost.

hypotheses.name: visual_epistemic_type_system
hypotheses.claim: Visual values should carry epistemic types such as OBSERVED, INFERRED, REMEMBERED, EXPECTED and CONFLICT so downstream consumers cannot silently conflate them.
hypotheses.falsifier: Equivalent safety/replay is achieved without epistemic typing.

hypotheses.name: world_model_as_generator
hypotheses.claim: The world model should generate candidate interpretations and sensing questions but should not directly mutate Evidence Plane truth.
hypotheses.falsifier: Direct world-to-percept writes are equally calibrated and safer/simpler under misleading priors.

hypotheses.name: adaptive_object_sampling
hypotheses.claim: Different world entities should receive different visual refresh rates based on uncertainty, motion, relevance and risk rather than one global camera-analysis cadence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Uniform sampling is Pareto-equal or superior.

hypotheses.name: causal_feature_custody
hypotheses.claim: A visual feature should only be retained long-term when its downstream causal use/value or future uncertainty reduction justifies its storage cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Value-aware retention loses important future tasks or fails to reduce state growth.

hypotheses.name: dual_persistence
hypotheses.claim: Fast volatile perceptual state and slower durable world state should have different persistence/recovery policies even inside one logical Clay substrate.
hypotheses.falsifier: One durability policy provides equal latency, recovery and correctness.

hypotheses.name: counterfactual_percept_replay
hypotheses.claim: Replaying the same sensor evidence under altered priors/feedback is the highest-information method to determine whether a visual belief is sensor-driven or expectation-driven.
hypotheses.falsifier: Simpler observational diagnostics identify prior contamination equally well.

hypotheses.name: representation_independent_sensor_semantics
hypotheses.claim: Sensor evidence semantics can stay stable while physical backing switches among full frames, deltas, event hardware or cached regions, enabling platform-specific lowerings.
hypotheses.falsifier: Required semantic behavior depends irreducibly on one physical representation.

hypotheses.name: kernel_hot_swap_shadowing
hypotheses.claim: Vision kernels can run in shadow mode against stable Evidence/Percept contracts, allowing encoder/detector replacement without rewriting cognitive architecture.
hypotheses.falsifier: Kernel swaps routinely require semantic-contract changes rather than lowerings/adapters.

hypotheses.name: continuous_shadow_baseline
hypotheses.claim: Retina should continuously retain a simple stateless baseline on sampled frames so complex recurrent gains and regressions remain measurable during development.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shadow baseline cost is unjustified or does not expose regressions earlier.

hypotheses.name: minimal_sufficient_visual_assembly
hypotheses.claim: For a given cognitive decision there exists a much smaller sufficient visual state than either the raw frame or full Retina narrative, and ClayGraph/GWT can approximate it online.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compressed Assemblies consistently omit information required by the 4B or are not smaller.

hypotheses.name: learned_projection_not_learned_truth
hypotheses.claim: A trainable model-facing visual projection may be useful, but its learned compression must remain downstream of authoritative evidence/provenance and cannot become canonical truth.
hypotheses.falsifier: A learned latent-only state proves equally replayable/auditable/robust under model changes.

hypotheses.name: visual_information_router
hypotheses.claim: Retina can be reframed as an information router that selects transformations based on uncertainty/task value instead of a fixed pipeline of all models.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fixed parallel all-model execution is Pareto-superior on representative workloads.

hypotheses.name: relation_first_escalation
hypotheses.claim: Unexpected relations or binding conflicts should trigger expensive visual reasoning more often than already-stable object identities.
hypotheses.falsifier: Object-confidence uncertainty alone predicts expensive-stage utility equally well.

hypotheses.name: action_conditioned_prediction
hypotheses.claim: After FRANK acts, the perceptual system should predict specific expected visual consequences and score mismatch as action-outcome evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Generic post-action refresh provides equal causal attribution without action-conditioned expectations.

hypotheses.name: perceptual_firebreak
hypotheses.claim: A deterministic firebreak between Perceptual Inference and persistent World Integration can prevent one-frame semantic hallucinations from contaminating long-term memory while preserving low latency.
hypotheses.falsifier: Immediate integration has equal contamination/recovery and lower complexity.

hypotheses.name: conflict_preserving_fusion
hypotheses.claim: When two visual kernels disagree, preserving the conflict into a typed state can be more valuable than immediately choosing the highest score.
hypotheses.falsifier: Immediate calibrated fusion yields equal downstream decisions and less state cost.

hypotheses.name: visual_compute_market
hypotheses.claim: Visual transformations can be assigned explicit cost/value budgets so the scheduler buys only the evidence expected to change a decision or world state.
hypotheses.falsifier: Cost accounting does not reduce compute or harms important-event recall relative to static routing.

hypotheses.name: perceptual_sufficiency_certificate
hypotheses.claim: A local visual episode can emit a sufficiency receipt explaining why no GWT/model escalation was needed, improving auditability of ignored frames.
hypotheses.falsifier: Receipts add overhead without detecting missed escalations or improving replay.

hypotheses.name: multimodal_agency_loop
hypotheses.claim: The best evidence for functional multimodality is not image-question accuracy but a closed visual action loop: perceive -> decide -> act -> visually verify -> update -> recover over long horizons.
hypotheses.falsifier: Static image QA predicts or substitutes for long-horizon visual action competence at equal reliability.

hypotheses.name: perceptual_state_compiler
hypotheses.claim: ClayCode can compile high-level perceptual contracts into different platform-specific fast paths (x86 frame-delta, Android camera/NPU, event sensor) while preserving the same semantic traces.
hypotheses.falsifier: Platform implementations require incompatible cognitive semantics rather than lowerings.
